about: Every color, line, fill, legend label and toggle title on the apps' maps. colors and labels: by key (bike-I, truck-Through, speed-25, zoning.residential, landuse.01, districts.council, boards.chip.subway, cb6map.overlay.parks, profile.bike, civicmap.<layer>.<color key>, findmap.<key>, weather.<hex>). numbers: widths, fills and alphas by key. layers: a drawn layer by screen and id (boards:truck, profile:bus, cb6map:historic, feeds:f...), each taking color (#RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA), alpha, width, fill and dash; a key without the screen applies on every map. Leave a value out and the app's own value stands. icons: a point layer's badge by key (cb6map:schools, cb6map:childcare, cb6map:libraries, parks-icons; the screen prefix is optional): mi:<file in civic/mapicons>, img:<file in civic/img>, a logo file name, or sf:<SF Symbol>#<hex>. Marker layers of your own go in civic/markers.json. Every color written in the apps' code is here too, by <File>.c.<id> (where says which file and line), the theme colors as theme.<name>, every map badge by <File>.i.<id> under icons, the type scale as numbers theme.textScale and the font names as labels theme.font.*. "symbols" (builds from 117): every SF symbol the apps draw, by <File>.s.<id> with the name the code uses; put another SF symbol name there and that icon changes. This is BKCB's copy (app/data/variants/bk/civic/mapstyle.json): its theme is the seal of Brooklyn, blue #1a3a6b and gold #d6a525. "numbers" also holds <File>.n.<name> (builds from 121): the code's list caps (capN), day windows (daysN), the 150 m radius (radiusMeters) and the park limit (parkMeters); change the value and the app uses it.
